subject.title: [Bug]: Non-Anthropic models output tool calls as plain text '[tool: exec]' instead of tool_use blocks

question: What should OpenClaw do when a model emits only a bare tool marker such as `[tool: exec]` with no structured tool call and no arguments?
rationale: Source inspection shows current repair can only promote parseable payloads; choosing retry, fallback, warning, blocking, or model-specific prompting changes provider/runtime compatibility policy rather than a narrow parser bug.

options.title: Detect and fail over or warn without execution
options.body: Treat bare markers as tool-call incompatibility, keep them out of user-visible replies where feasible, and either retry/fall through or surface a clear provider-capability warning without inventing tool arguments.

options.title: Tune model/provider formatting first
options.body: Document or configure forced tool-choice and reduced tool surfaces for affected models before adding automatic runtime recovery.

options.title: Promote only complete textual calls
options.body: Keep current strict promotion semantics and only execute textual tool calls that include parseable arguments, leaving bare markers as diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Detect and fail over or warn without execution
recommendation.body: Treat bare markers as tool-call incompatibility, keep them out of user-visible replies where feasible, and either retry/fall through or surface a clear provider-capability warning without inventing tool arguments.
